OfflineVisibilityInfo: Unlike Telegram's built-in Last Seen privacy setting, Hide 'Online' status keeps you offline while browsing without blocking you from seeing others' exact Last Seen (no Premium needed). However, Telegram's servers will still briefly mark you online for about 30–60 seconds whenever you send messages, react, or mark chats as read. For the best result, enable all Ghost Mode options.
